SELECT cust_list.wsort, cust_list.number, Trim$(nz([fname])) AS Expr1, Trim$(nz([pname])) AS Expr2, cust_list.tel, cust_list.numw, cust_list.CDate, cust_list.chdate, Trim$(nz([fname]))+" "+Trim$(nz([pname])) AS namew, Trim$(nz([address]))+"  "+Trim$(nz([city])) AS addro, Trim$(nz([city])) AS addr, cust_list.mkor, cust_list.kamp
FROM cust_list
WHERE (((Val(nz([ocupation])))<>-1))
GROUP BY cust_list.wsort, cust_list.number, Trim$(nz([fname])), Trim$(nz([pname])), cust_list.tel, cust_list.numw, cust_list.CDate, cust_list.chdate, Trim$(nz([fname]))+" "+Trim$(nz([pname])), Trim$(nz([address]))+"  "+Trim$(nz([city])), Trim$(nz([city])), cust_list.mkor, cust_list.kamp
HAVING (((cust_list.number)>0))
ORDER BY Trim$(nz([fname])), Trim$(nz([pname])), Trim$(nz([address]))+"  "+Trim$(nz([city])), Trim$(nz([city]));

FROM (tb_q_orders LEFT JOIN cust_list ON tb_q_orders.numw=cust_list.numw) LEFT JOIN tb_q_catalogb ON tb_q_orders.qsmodel=tb_q_catalogb.qsmodel

ORDER BY tb_q_orders.odate, tb_q_orders.qsmodelb;

FROM tb_q_catalog INNER JOIN tbq_upd_amount ON tb_q_catalog.wnum = tbq_upd_amount.rnum

SELECT nz([sel]) AS qsel, nz(Format([datew],"Short Date")) AS wdate, Format([qhour],"Short Time") AS timew, Trim$(nz([pname]))+" "+Trim$(nz([fname])) AS qname, nz([snif]) AS Expr1, tb_date_list.dn
FROM tb_date_list INNER JOIN cust_list ON tb_date_list.codel=cust_list.numw
WHERE (((nz([sel]))<>"") And ((nz([snif]))=IIf(nz(Forms!Calendar_of_Attendance!qsnif)<>"",nz(Forms!Calendar_of_Attendance!qsnif),nz([snif]))) And ((tb_date_list.dn)=False) And ((tb_date_list.datew)>=Forms!Calendar_of_Attendance!sd And (tb_date_list.datew)<=Forms!Calendar_of_Attendance!ed) And ((Val(nz([codel])))<>0))
ORDER BY tb_date_list.datew;

GROUP BY qlist_datep.numw
ORDER BY qlist_datep.numw, Max(qlist_datep.caddate) DESC;

Name: qlist_datep
SQL:
SELECT adchecks.caddate, adchecks.numw
FROM adchecks
GROUP BY adchecks.caddate, adchecks.numw
HAVING (((adchecks.caddate) Is Not Null));
UNION SELECT checks.chdate, checks.numw
FROM checks
GROUP BY checks.chdate, checks.numw
HAVING (((checks.chdate) Is Not Null));
UNION SELECT orders.odate, orders.numw
FROM orders
GROUP BY orders.odate, orders.numw
HAVING (((orders.odate) Is Not Null));
UNION SELECT cust_list.chdate, cust_list.numw
FROM cust_list
GROUP BY cust_list.chdate, cust_list.numw
HAVING (((cust_list.chdate) Is Not Null));
UNION SELECT cust_list.cdate, cust_list.numw
FROM cust_list
GROUP BY cust_list.cdate, cust_list.numw
HAVING (((cust_list.cdate) Is Not Null));

SELECT tb_date_list.datew, tb_date_list.mem, IIf(nz([fname])<>"",nz([fname]) & " " & nz([pname]),Null) AS qname, Format([qhour],"Short Time") AS fqhour, Format([qhoure],"Short Time") AS fqhoure, tb_date_list.qhourf, tb_date_list.dn, tb_date_list.type, tb_date_list.wnum, tb_date_list.codel, tb_date_list.snif
FROM tb_date_list LEFT JOIN cust_list ON tb_date_list.codel=cust_list.numw

ORDER BY tb_date_list.datew, Format([qhour],"Short Time");

SQL:

פרטי-לקוח
SQL:
SELECT letter_labels.numw AS קוד, letter_labels.fname AS [שם-משפחה], letter_labels.pname AS [שם-פרטי], letter_labels.lang AS שפה, letter_labels.Min AS מין, letter_labels.zehut AS [ת-זהות], letter_labels.sel AS סלולרי, letter_labels.tel AS טלפון, letter_labels.email AS אימייל, letter_labels.waddress AS כתובת, letter_labels.wcity AS עיר, letter_labels.pdate AS [תאריך-פתיחה], letter_labels.ldate AS [ת-ביקור-אחרון], letter_labels.bdate AS [ת-לידה]
FROM letter_labels;

Name: קטלוג-מסגרות
קטלוג-עדשות
תקבול_הזמנה
SQL:
SELECT q_tashlumim_xls.namew AS [שם לקוח], q_tashlumim_xls.ordernum AS [מספר הזמנה], q_tashlumim_xls.typ AS [אופן תשלום], q_tashlumim_xls.odate AS [תאריך הזמנה], q_tashlumim_xls.wdate AS [תאריך תשלום], q_tashlumim_xls.tpiraon AS [תאריך פירעון], q_tashlumim_xls.total AS סכום, q_tashlumim_xls.qtotal AS מתוך, q_tashlumim_xls.qpay AS תשלומים, q_tashlumim_xls.qpayn AS [מספר תשלום]
FROM q_tashlumim_xls
WHERE (((q_tashlumim_xls.odate)>=IIf(nz([Forms]![s_takbul]![fwdate])="",#1/1/1980#,[Forms]![s_takbul]![fwdate]) And (q_tashlumim_xls.odate)<=IIf(nz([Forms]![s_takbul]![twdate])="",Date(),[Forms]![s_takbul]![twdate])))
ORDER BY q_tashlumim_xls.odate;

SQL:
SELECT q_tashlumim_xls.namew AS [שם לקוח], q_tashlumim_xls.ordernum AS [מספר הזמנה], q_tashlumim_xls.typ AS [אופן תשלום], q_tashlumim_xls.odate AS [תאריך הזמנה], q_tashlumim_xls.wdate AS [תאריך תשלום], q_tashlumim_xls.tpiraon AS [תאריך פירעון], q_tashlumim_xls.total AS סכום, q_tashlumim_xls.qtotal AS מתוך, q_tashlumim_xls.qpay AS תשלומים, q_tashlumim_xls.qpayn AS [מספר תשלום]
FROM q_tashlumim_xls
WHERE (((q_tashlumim_xls.tpiraon)>=IIf(nz([Forms]![s_takbul]![fwdate])="",#1/1/1980#,[Forms]![s_takbul]![fwdate]) And (q_tashlumim_xls.tpiraon)<=IIf(nz([Forms]![s_takbul]![twdate])="",#1/1/2100#,[Forms]![s_takbul]![twdate])))

Name: תקבול_תשלום
SQL:
SELECT q_tashlumim_xls.namew AS [שם לקוח], q_tashlumim_xls.ordernum AS [מספר הזמנה], q_tashlumim_xls.typ AS [אופן תשלום], q_tashlumim_xls.odate AS [תאריך הזמנה], q_tashlumim_xls.wdate AS [תאריך תשלום], q_tashlumim_xls.tpiraon AS [תאריך פירעון], q_tashlumim_xls.total AS סכום, q_tashlumim_xls.qtotal AS מתוך, q_tashlumim_xls.qpay AS תשלומים, q_tashlumim_xls.qpayn AS [מספר תשלום]
FROM q_tashlumim_xls
WHERE (((q_tashlumim_xls.typ)=IIf(nz(Forms!s_takbul!qtyp)="",[typ],nz(Forms!s_takbul!qtyp))) And ((q_tashlumim_xls.wdate)>=IIf(nz(Forms!s_takbul!fwdate)="",#1/1/1980#,Forms!s_takbul!fwdate) And (q_tashlumim_xls.wdate)<=IIf(nz(Forms!s_takbul!twdate)="",Date(),Forms!s_takbul!twdate)))
ORDER BY q_tashlumim_xls.wdate;
